subject: general
question: Town F is to the north of Town G. Town H is to the east of Town F. Town I is to the south of Town H. Town J is to the west of Town I. Town G is to the south-west of Town J. What is the position of Town F with respect to Town J?
solution:
Given:

Town F is to the north of Town G.

Town H is to the east of Town F.

Town I is to the south of Town H.

Town J is to the west of Town I.

Town G is to the south-west of Town J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dca0f112b5a9aa1e8c63398f4419e9cd82df969c61dc15868b5774d1b6027bc.png] 

Thus, town F is to the north-west of Town J.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
